title: Functions Practice 2
statement:
Module 3 (Functions) covers: specificity and cascade, borders and outlines, overflow and clipping, transforms, filters and blend modes, css transforms. Solve this practice problem using what you learned.

Exercise 2: write a small program that demonstrates one concept from this module (Borders and Outlines).
hints: Re-read the Borders and Outlines lesson example.
Start by declaring your variables, then add the core logic.
Test with the simplest input first, then edge cases.
solutionExplanation: A correct solution applies the module concepts in a small working program.
